import pytest

from yt_dlp.voxel_route import route_cells


class TestGridPathProbeQA:
    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        ("u", "v"),
        [
            (6, 9),
            (1, 1),
            (0, 15),
            (3, 12),
            (8, 8),
            (2, 7),
            (14, 1),
            (5, 5),
            (11, 4),
            (9, 0),
            (13, 13),
            (4, 11),
            (10, 6),
            (7, 3),
            (12, 14),
            (15, 2),
            (0, 0),
            (1, 14),
        ],
    )
    def test_grid_path_probe_cases(self, u: int, v: int) -> None:
        r = route_cells(u, v)
        assert isinstance(r, int)
        assert 0 <= r <= 0xFF

"""Voxel routing helpers for QA harness fixtures."""

from __future__ import annotations

_phase = 0


def route_cells(u: int, v: int) -> int:
    global _phase
    _phase += 1
    acc = (int(u) & 0xF) ^ (int(v) & 0xF)
    if _phase & 1:
        bump = (acc << 1) ^ 5
        out = bump & 0xFF
    else:
        bump = acc | 0x10
        out = (bump + 1) & 0xFF
    return out
